checks: The capture URL index, offline manifest and every JavaScript, CSS and WASM runtime asset match the independently retained public-build hashes before browser capture.

Input group navigation preserves the selected report and inspected arrangement. Report navigation preserves an unfinished staffing value. Forms → YAML → Forms preserves that draft while YAML and the exported native run still contain the saved value; switching views applies nothing.

The staffing Form saves the third callout as awaiting review. Explicit floor-lead input acceptance and venue-manager reassessment and result acceptance leave only holding feasible. The native case matches the archived changed inputs while preserving the exact pinned definition and earlier proposal/authorization; the current choice and specific authorization remain outstanding.

The current configured Reports → Expense recovery view and four-deployment comparison retain the exact original native case. Excel starts collapsed and opens as an optional input tool; viewing it performs no review or calculation.
